# Agent Skills — Japan SSW Platform (`mmdc-wst`)

This directory contains the skill profiles for each specialized Copilot agent role.
Each role has its own folder with a dedicated `SKILL.MD` defining responsibilities,
tech stack, conventions, and cross-role links.

## Agent Roles

| Role | Folder | Key Technologies |
|---|---|---|
| 🎨 Frontend Developer | [`frontend-developer/`](./frontend-developer/SKILL.MD) | HTML5, Bootstrap 5.3, Tailwind CSS, JS ES6 |
| ⚙️ Backend Developer | [`backend-developer/`](./backend-developer/SKILL.MD) | Node 18, Express 5, JWT, Passport, Swagger |
| 🗄️ Database Architect | [`database-architect/`](./database-architect/SKILL.MD) | Mongoose v9, MongoDB Atlas |
| 🚀 DevOps Engineer | [`devops-engineer/`](./devops-engineer/SKILL.MD) | GitHub Actions, Terraform, Fly.io, Vercel, Railway |
| 📄 Documentation Specialist | [`documentation-specialist/`](./documentation-specialist/SKILL.MD) | Mermaid, Shields.io, Swagger/OpenAPI |
| 🧪 Test Engineer | [`test-engineer/`](./test-engineer/SKILL.MD) | Playwright, Jest, Supertest |
| 🔐 Security Engineer | [`security-engineer/`](./security-engineer/SKILL.MD) | Helmet, JWT, OAuth, IAM, OIDC |
| 🌐 i18n Engineer | [`i18n-engineer/`](./i18n-engineer/SKILL.MD) | Locales (EN/JP), translate workflow |
| ☁️ AWS / Cloud Engineer | [`aws-cloud-engineer/`](./aws-cloud-engineer/SKILL.MD) | S3, IAM, STS, Terraform |

## Shared Conventions

All agents must follow the conventions in [`CONVENTIONS.MD`](./CONVENTIONS.MD).
